description: A jolt of caffeine. Sharpens you up for a while.

overdose.message: Your heart trips, stutters, and seizes. Too much caffeine, too fast: your chest goes tight and cold, and the world tips over.

comedown_message: The lift goes out of it. You could do with another.
The edge comes off, and the tiredness it was covering is still there.
Whatever that bought you, you have spent it.
phases.comeup_message: The first mouthful is just heat. The rest of it is on the way.
phases.end_message: Whatever that was, it's finished, and you're further behind than when you started.
peak_message: The caffeine lands. The day sharpens up a notch.
Somewhere behind your eyes a light comes on.
The fog lifts off the front of your head and stays off.

withdrawal.message: Your head has a pulse in it, and the light is louder than it was.

stages.easing: The head clears from the outside inward. There's a warm spot left in the middle of it.
stages.onset: A dull pressure starts up behind one eye and settles in.
stages.peak: Light is too bright and sound is too close, and you've read the same line four times without any of it going in.
stages.rising: The headache has arrived properly now, and it has a pulse, and the pulse is yours.
stages.tail: Functional. You surface about an hour later than you used to, and it takes the whole morning to be any use.

name: coffee
